A file with this name exists already in: Drive screen (cloud drive of the admin): error after an upload: a file with the same name is already in the target folder.
Being checked__drive-card-state: Agent chat, file card of the drive: state line of a file whose malware check is still running (not yet downloadable).
Blocked__drive-card-state: Agent chat, file card of the drive: state line of a file the malware check blocked (cannot be opened or downloaded).
Choose a space: Drive screen: placeholder of the space picker button when no space is chosen (a space = one storage area of the drive).
Current versions: Drive screen, tooltip of the storage pill: part of the used storage taken by the current version of each file.
Downloaded__file-event: File manager details drawer, history: event type: someone downloaded the file.
Drive: Drive screen (cloud drive of the admin): page title of the file storage screen.
Drive screen, space picker: shown when the search finds no space.
Older versions: Drive screen, tooltip of the storage pill: part of the used storage taken by older, kept versions of files.
Drive screen: error when a new version of a file cannot be uploaded because the file's details are not loaded; the user should reopen the file.
Read by the agent: File manager details drawer, history: event type: the AI agent read the file.
Search spaces…: Drive screen, space picker: placeholder of the search field.
Drive screen: error when the server confirmed an upload but returned no file.
Error under the path field when looking up the typed path failed for another reason than 'not found' (for example a network error).
Drive screen: error message when the list of storage spaces failed to load.
Drive screen: empty state: the signed-in user may read no storage space.
This drive needs mgamadeus/ddd-clouddriv: Drive screen: shown to developers when the server's drive module is too old for this screen; keep the package name and version as they are.
Trash__drive-usage: Drive screen, tooltip of the storage pill: part of the used storage taken by files in the trash.
Uploads being checked: Drive screen, tooltip of the storage pill: part of the used storage taken by uploads still in the malware check.
Viewed__file-event: File manager details drawer, history: event type: someone opened the file's preview.
Written by a third party__drive-card-sta: Agent chat, file card of the drive: state line of a file whose content came from outside (e.g. a mail attachment or a web page), not from the owner.
You may read this space, but not change: Notice above the drive's file list when the user may open and download files of this space but not upload, rename, move or delete.
